about: Rust-produced outcomes of the promote panel's commands over real files (keeper_agent::promote, test every_command_vector_holds; KEEPER_WRITE_VECTORS=1 writes each step's expect, then biome formats the file), which src/test/mock-shell-promote-commands.test.ts replays through the dev harness's own handlers. A file's changed is its mtime in ms; a vault copy is its text with each reviewer's review written in by keeper; a step's item is the index of a row, then of an unlisted file, of the last panel.
